bibl.title: A New Join for Sappho's "Kypris Poem": P.GC. inv. 105 fr. 4 and P.Sapph.Obbink.
bibl.note: P. Coll. privées: P. Green Inv. 105 (= MP3 1445.01; LDAB 341738), fr. 4, joins P. Coll. privées [P. Sapph. Obbink] (= MP3 1445.02; LDAB 341738), ll. 25-28, and establishes the beginnings of lines 5-8 of the "Kypris Poem".
